headline: Itaú Cuts Brazil 2027 Growth Forecast to 0.5% Amid Weak Real and Inflation
summary: Brazil's Itaú halved its 2027 growth forecast to 0.5% and expects the central bank to hold rates at 13.75% as the currency weakens and inflation climbs.
why: Private sector macroeconomic forecasts from major financial institutions shape domestic yield curves, equity valuations, and foreign investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Downward revisions to GDP growth expectations signal a deteriorating economic outlook.
